title: CAN Pack
text: Pack individual signals into CAN message, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Data input as} sets Select your; {Database file} sets the aRXML or CAN database file character, {Message list} sets the cAN message list array of character, {Name} sets the cAN message name, {Identifier type} sets the cAN identifier type Standard, {CAN Identifier} sets the cAN message ID, {Specify CAN identifier from input port} sets the cAN message ID value, {Length (bytes)} sets the cAN message length, {Remote frame} sets the cAN message as remote frame, {Output as bus} sets the cAN message as bus, {Add signal} adds CAN signal, {Delete signal} sets the remove CAN signal and {Signals}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: CAN message signal input single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | boolean

ports.name: CAN Msg ID
ports.summary: CAN message identifier single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64

params.name: Data input as
params.values: Select your data signal raw data (default) | manually specified signals | CANdb specified signals | ARXML specified signals

params.name: Database file
params.values: ARXML or CAN database file character vector

params.name: Message list
params.values: CAN message list array of character vectors

params.name: Name
params.values: CAN message name CAN Msg (default) | character vector

params.name: Identifier type
params.values: CAN identifier type Standard (11-bit identifier) (default) | Extended (29-bit identifier)

params.name: Specify CAN identifier from input port
params.values: CAN message ID value off (default) | on

params.name: Remote frame
params.values: CAN message as remote frame off (default) | on

params.name: Output as bus
params.values: CAN message as bus off (default) | on
